query: Which spatially-robust inference methods (cluster schemes, spatial HAC, spatial wild bootstrap) provide reliable size control under regional spatial correlation and panel dependence?

response.query: Which spatially-robust inference methods (cluster schemes, spatial HAC, spatial wild bootstrap) provide reliable size control under regional spatial correlation and panel dependence?
response.answer: Spatial HAC and spatial wild bootstrap methods provide reliable size control under regional spatial correlation and panel dependence. These methods are robust to spatial autocorrelation issues.
